changes: Fixed a real bug caught from a live screenshot: cards were being dealt correctly, but the table never actually entered 'playing' status anywhere in the code — it stayed 'waiting' through the whole hand. That one missing line meant the dealer's cards never showed, the turn highlight never appeared, and Hit/Stand/Double never showed up even though a real hand was genuinely in progress underneath. Also means the existing 'a hand is already in progress' safety checks on setBet and dealHand were silently doing nothing this whole time — both now actually work as intended.
